schema.identity: Exact UTF-8 capture account/Space, source head, payload FileID, referring owner, property key/index, original variant path and destination owner sourceKey stay distinct; dictionaries reject both byte duplicates and Swift-normalization aliases.
schema.fileHead: Captured nativeType=533/FileObject, exactly one captured File Type descriptor with recommendedLayout=6, no snapshot issues, explicit indexed status, current details/FileInfo/payload correspondence. Legacy nativeType256 and specialized layouts8/15/16/20 remain refused.
schema.positiveReferences: Require exact exhaustive five-key reference-row census. Every admitted head has one fileInfo.fileId self row and the generated self-file block row at its actual source block-array index; every ordinary use has an exact details.<key>[<index>] row and the raw captured scalar/array element equal to that head. No unconsumed reference, file head or payload is accepted.
schema.referringOwner: Each payload/head must have exactly one distinct supported Page/Bookmark referring owner; multiple fields/elements on that owner may reuse its single planned file. Multiple owners, one payload under multiple heads, orphan files, legacy rows, icons/covers/bookmarks and arbitrary referring-document file blocks refuse.
schema.variants: First scope requires one declared native-original generic-file variant for each payload and no additional unhandled variants. Its verified bytes/SHA, original name/MIME, captured metadata member, variant ID/path and FileInfo keys must correspond exactly to the indexed head; no payload-ID-as-head substitution.

generatedBody.root: One smartblock at sourceObjectID with header then generated file/info/description/fileExt and the source-derived nonzero common relation blocks; no extra or unreachable block.
generatedBody.header: Header layout Style3 containing title then featuredRelations. Title Style7 has exact name/done details binding and no standalone body text; empty featured content, no invented editable title.
generatedBody.file: ID=file, targetObjectId=head, empty legacy hash, Type1/File, State2/Done, Style0/Auto, name/MIME/size/addedAt equal the admitted head. Int64 JSON fields are parsed as exact bounded decimal strings, not doubles.
generatedBody.info: ID=info, exact File Information paragraph and one Bold3 UTF16 range0...16 with empty parameter; description/fileExt and optional sizeInBytes/origin/importType/addedDate blocks use their exact same-key relation.
generatedBody.defaults: Explicit original JSON default keys/values and all-block restrictions read=false/edit=true/remove=true/drag=true/dropOn=true; no unknown common/content field, custom alignment/background, arbitrary marks or children.
generatedBody.qualification: This shape comes from the exact original constructor and protobuf schema, not a positive real captured file fixture.

activeProjection: verified original payload size and SHA
details.retainedOnly: FileInfo encryption/variant metadata, source creation/modification/import/sync/index metadata, generated file-head body and original native tree/protobuf remain exact in private archive and immutable source catalog. They are not destination live providers or transplanted history.
details.admission: A closed constructor-derived typed key set plus the already-defined original identity/provenance fields. Each relationLink must resolve to the exact captured descriptor/format. Unknown/custom detail or relation behavior, nonempty unimplemented description, renamed head/name+extension mismatch, unsupported variants, nonzero dimension/media fields and unindexed/pending source refuse instead of becoming silently ignored.
details.fileSchemaDisposition: Collect the exact file-associated Type/descriptor dependency IDs separately. Exclude them from the uninstantiated-definition claim and mark their immutable catalog roles as retained-file-schema; mark file heads retained-file-attachment-head. The File Type remains inactive and allImportedTypesUsable stays false.

predecessor.supersededFinding: A normal indexed file head is not block-free. Its generated self-file block, title/header, metadata blocks, and exact reference rows must be admitted explicitly.

capability: Direct-captured original generic-file attachments in ordinary Page/Bookmark properties, using the existing prepared file API and the exact mapped referring document as destination owner. This does not create an editable destination File-Type object or claim full File/Image/Audio/Video family migration.

reference.positiveJoin: Exact UTF-8 referring owner + details.<key>[<index>] row with LegacyFileID=false; exact current captured raw scalar/list value equals TargetObjectID; unique captured target head and fileInfo.fileId self row both bind that same head to FileID; verified original variant binds FileID to payload metadata and bytes.
reference.noConflation: TargetObjectID, FileID, native destination owner objectID, and native destination fileID remain separate typed identities.

implementation.pureClosure: New AnyHeartNativeCapturedFilePlan (and a small dedicated original-file-head validator if needed). It reconstructs a closed immutable attachment plan from the verified captured bundle, exact catalog and current Page/Bookmark selection. No public caller can inject an arbitrary owner or file mapping.
implementation.values: DefinitionPlan gains an explicit typed projection argument. Only this path accepts native scalar/ordered-array file values and maps TargetObjectID through the admitted plan. Legacy AnyHeartNativeFileBinding behavior stays exact; original default/cardinality/target-Type/native-schema guards are preserved.
implementation.composition: Page/Bookmark pass the verified projection. ContentComposition appends one file operation per admitted head, after mapped owners and before deferred properties, attributed to the exact referring document/source relation closure. File head/payload source identities stay in the conditional material. Current subset admission remains explicitly partial; Producer executes only the enclosing whole preservation plan with full live source revalidation.
implementation.preservation: Only capturedComplete with a fully admitted nonempty closure relaxes the nonempty-file refusal. Every original native head still has its own immutable catalog row and all file metadata/payload members remain in the reversible archive. Recovered v1 and zero-file branches retain exact prior behavior/bytes.
implementation.payloadOwnership: Producer materializes only declared verified payload members in the existing private anchored storage scope and dispatches exact sourceKey-to-file requests. Existing native clients still choose inline/full by the original size contract; no new upload API, same-payload cross-owner assumption or destination ownership override.
implementation.unchanged: Existing Executor, Journal, prepared native clients, current Writer/READ/run/lease checks, C14 partition, cold routing, E outer-operation lifetime and App persistence obligations stay. W3 ca3c Directory fix remains an explicit whole-file prerequisite, not a reconstructed edit.
implementation.originalByteRegression: Omit all new optional material on the empty-file route. Require original accepted zero-file current-content/preservation plans and both cold reference encodings byte-equal, without replaying original182.

limits.acceptedTypesUnchanged: Supported current editable objects remain Page and Bookmark only.

focusedControls: Constructor-shaped synthetic generic head with positive self/file-block/detail rows and distinct head/payload/owner IDs yields one deterministic file intent and exact mapped property order.
Every changed row/head/payload/variant/filename/MIME/size/proto numeric/default correspondence refuses at the intended typed boundary.
Shared owners/heads/payloads, UTF8-normalization aliases, orphan/unconsumed rows, legacy references and arbitrary Page file blocks refuse.
Generated metadata/body validation rejects unsupported custom fields/layouts/states/extra blocks instead of archiving them as active functionality.
Zero-file old canonical bytes remain equal and the new cold content projection retains file item intent/provenance without treating its source carrier as an editable document.
Exact private payload selection/reuse, bounded size failure and 4095/4096 prepared-client boundary remain separate from actual live native file acceptance.
futureNativeAcceptance: A separately owned genuine nonempty Heart capture is mandatory before claiming actual original file migration. It must perform current prepared Writer checks, exact typed file/property readback and complete native byte download/hash, cold reopen/current lease refusal, source stability and full terminal audits. Existing C20 Files=[] and original159/156 are not this evidence.
reviewRequest: Review this finite source/owner/retained-head contract before production hooks. No compiler/controller/resource change is included.
